pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to sinwan-engine: what it is, why it exists, its multi-protocol philosophy, and how the major subsystems relate. Links to child pages for deeper coverage.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Installation, environment requirements (Bun runtime), basic project setup, build pipeline (build.ts), TypeScript configuration, and a minimal 'Hello World' HTTP server example.

page_notes.content: Sinwan.listen() is an async method, so you should call it with await: await app.listen(3000); sinwan.ts:620-626

pages.title: Core Concepts
pages.purpose: Explains the engine-driven pipeline (no next() pattern), context pooling, registration-order semantics, baked handler chains, and the unified multi-protocol model. Foundational reading before diving into subsystems.

pages.title: The Sinwan Class
pages.purpose: Overview of the central Sinwan application class — its constructor, static factory, plugin/module registration, and how it wires together all internal subsystems. Links to child pages for lifecycle and module system details.

pages.title: Lifecycle Management
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the LifecycleManager state machine: IDLE → INIT → READY → SHUTDOWN → DESTROYED transitions, async sequential event emission, guard assertions, and integration with listen/stop.

pages.title: Plugin and Module System
pages.purpose: Explains the Plugin interface (install(runtime)), SinwanModule interface (register(app)), all createXxxModule factory functions, HTTPRouterFluent wrapper, scoped routing, and the GRPCProvider registry pattern.

pages.title: Request Pipeline and Runtime
pages.purpose: Overview of how a request flows from Bun.serve through the Runtime.fetch pipeline to a final Response. Links to child pages for the runtime engine, context object, and response building.

pages.title: Runtime Engine
pages.purpose: Detailed coverage of the Runtime class: context pool acquisition/release, the five-stage fetch pipeline (internal assets gate → WS upgrade → HTTP routing → finalization → event emission), error orchestration, and persistent-body handling for streams/SSE.

pages.title: Context Object
pages.purpose: Comprehensive reference for the Context class: lifecycle flags (STOPPED, RESPONDED, STREAMING, SKIPPED, FAILED), response commit methods (json/text/stream/sse/file), body parsing with size limits, redirect-with-flash, state vs global maps, event scoping, and the disposal/pooling mechanism.

pages.title: Response Building
pages.purpose: Covers the buildResponse function: fast-path string handling, null/empty bodies, stream/Buffer/Blob/AsyncIterator pass-through, JSON fallback, lazy header allocation, and SSE detection.

pages.title: Routing
pages.purpose: Overview of the routing layer across all supported protocols. Links to child pages for HTTP routing and the non-HTTP protocol routers.

pages.title: HTTP Router
pages.purpose: Deep dive into HTTPRouter: dual-path resolution (static fast-path + radix tree), RadixNode structure, registration-order middleware baking, route groups and mounting, HEAD-to-GET fallback, ALL-bucket fallback, 405 detection, the runChain handler executor, and the secured static file server.

pages.title: WebSocket Router
pages.purpose: Covers WSRouter: route registration via ws(), the tryUpgrade HTTP-to-WS bridge, WSSData state migration, allowedStateKeys security, buildWebSocketHandlers for Bun.serve, hook lifecycle (upgrade/open/message/close/drain/ping/pong), and backpressure configuration.

pages.title: TCP and UDP Routers
pages.purpose: Covers TCPRouter (listen/connect, TLS, Unix sockets, hook lifecycle, server tracking, stop) and UDPRouter (udpSocket, datagram hooks, multicast). Explains the SinwanTCPData/SinwanUDPSocket wrappers and context acquisition/release patterns.

pages.title: Event Bus and Type System
pages.purpose: Overview of the EventBus and the central types.ts definitions. Links to child pages for the event bus internals and the full type inventory.

pages.title: EventBus
pages.purpose: Detailed coverage of the EventBus: wildcard dispatch with hierarchical colon-delimited namespaces, LRU caches (dispatchCache, hasListenersCache), emitAsync/emitParallel/emitSync semantics, EmitResult STOP/CONTINUE flow control, AbortSignal listener cleanup, memory leak protections, and event tracing via ctx.recordEvent.

pages.title: Type System and Internal Event Map
pages.purpose: Reference for all key types exported from types.ts: LifecycleState/Event, InternalEventMap (request:start/end, response:set, ws:open, tcp:data, udp:data, grpc:call), ResponseKind, GRPCCallPayload, ErrorPayload, EventMeta, EventTraceEntry, and EventSource.

pages.title: Error Handling
pages.purpose: Overview of the error handling subsystem. Links to child pages for the normalizer and the full error handler.

pages.title: ErrorNormalizer
pages.purpose: Covers ErrorNormalizer: converting unknown thrown values to ErrorPayload, production vs development message masking, stack trace inclusion, statusCode extraction, the onError telemetry hook, and direct use by TCP/UDP/gRPC routers.

pages.title: ErrorHandler
pages.purpose: Covers ErrorHandler: the handle() lifecycle (normalize → telemetry → state check → format → transmit), HTML vs JSON response types, the formatHtmlError dark-themed page with XSS escaping, formatResponse callback override, HTTP_STATUS_LABELS lookup table, and double-response prevention.

pages.title: Built-in Middleware
pages.purpose: Overview of the middleware included with sinwan-engine. Links to child pages for CORS and InternalAssets.

pages.title: CORS Middleware
pages.purpose: Full reference for the cors() factory and cors.preflight(): CorsOptions schema, StaticOrigin vs OriginDelegate, CorsOptionsDelegate per-request reconfiguration, configureOrigin/configureAllowedHeaders logic, Vary de-duplication, short-circuit preflight flow, and integration with the baked handler chain.

pages.title: Internal Assets Handler
pages.purpose: Covers InternalAssets: default assets (favicon.ico, robots.txt, security.txt, sitemap.xml, manifest.json), passthrough patterns, block patterns, runtime register/unregister API, the handle() return values (handled/passthrough/continue), and InternalAssetsOptions configuration.

pages.title: gRPC Support
pages.purpose: Covers the optional gRPC subsystem: the GRPCProvider interface and registry (registerGRPCProvider/getGRPCProvider/hasGRPCProvider), the sinwan-grpc external package pattern, SocketHelper gRPC operations, GrpcContext, and the GRPCCallPayload event type.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: Overview of the test infrastructure and patterns used in sinwan-engine. Links to child pages for unit and integration testing approaches.

pages.title: Unit Testing Patterns
pages.purpose: Covers the Bun test runner setup, test helpers (helpers.ts), programmatic request injection via app.request(), mock GRPCProvider pattern, and how individual subsystems (EventBus, LifecycleManager, ErrorNormalizer, routers) are tested in isolation.

pages.title: Integration Testing
pages.purpose: Covers end-to-end integration test patterns: spinning up a live Bun server, testing HTTP/WS/TCP/UDP flows, error handler integration tests, and the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions workflows for CI and release).

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, class names, and architectural concepts that an onboarding engineer needs to know, with code pointers.
